websiteQuestions.question: what is Crowd Report
websiteQuestions.reply: **Crowd Report** is a modern civic issue resolution platform connecting citizens with certified municipal contractors and resolvers. Citizens can report public infrastructure hazards (potholes, water leaks, broken streetlights, uncollected waste) with GPS coordinates and photos. Resolvers inspect the site, provide an upfront quote, and complete repairs with verified before-and-after photo proof.

websiteQuestions.question: how does payment work
websiteQuestions.reply:
Crowd Report operates on a **50% Advance & 50% Balance Milestone Model**:
1. **50% Advance**: Paid upon quote approval to mobilize certified resolvers and procure repair materials.
2. **Escrow Protection**: Funds remain securely protected until work is finished.
3. **50% Balance**: Released only after the resolver uploads verified before/after proof and the resolution is confirmed.

websiteQuestions.question: how much does a pothole repair cost
websiteQuestions.reply:
Civic resolution fees depend on the service category and on-site inspection:
• **Base Fees**: Start from ₹300 (e.g., Garbage: ₹300, Streetlights: ₹350, Water Supply: ₹400, Drainage: ₹500, Road Damage: ₹600).
• **Milestone Quote**: A certified resolver conducts an on-site assessment to determine exact material & labor costs.
• **Escrow Guarantee**: No hidden surcharges; all costs are disclosed before advance payment.

websiteQuestions.question: how do I track my issue
websiteQuestions.reply:
You can track any civic issue using its unique **Issue Code** (e.g., `CR-2026-XXXX`):
• Go to the **Track Status** page at `/track` to view live progress without logging in.
• Registered citizens can also track all their reported issues under **Citizen Dashboard > My Issues**.
• Stages: *Submitted → Inspection Scheduled → Quote Approved → Work In Progress → Resolved & Verified*.

websiteQuestions.question: who are resolvers
websiteQuestions.reply:
**Resolvers** are certified local contractors, licensed technicians, and municipal service specialists. Every resolver undergoes:
• Identity, business, and GST verification
• Trade credential and insurance checks
• Ongoing performance, turnaround time, and citizen satisfaction ratings.

websiteQuestions.question: is my data safe
websiteQuestions.reply: **Your personal data is strictly protected.** We redact phone numbers, emails, and personal identification from public issue records. Resolvers only receive civic site coordinates and job descriptions. All transactions are encrypted and secured via enterprise payment gateways.

websiteQuestions.question: can I cancel my issue
websiteQuestions.reply: You can cancel a reported issue at any time **before the on-site inspection or quote confirmation** with zero penalty. If advance payment has already been made into escrow, cancellation is subject to resolver mobilization terms, with unutilized funds promptly refunded.

websiteQuestions.question: what happens after I report an issue
websiteQuestions.reply:
Here is what happens when you report an issue on Crowd Report:
1. **Submit**: Report the issue with category, GPS location, and photos.
2. **Inspection**: A certified resolver inspects the site and issues an itemized quote.
3. **50% Advance**: You approve the quote and deposit the 50% advance into escrow.
4. **Resolution**: The resolver completes the work and uploads time-stamped proof.
5. **50% Balance**: You verify completion and release the final payment.

websiteQuestions.question: is there an inspection before work starts
websiteQuestions.reply: **Yes, an on-site inspection occurs before repair work begins.** A certified municipal resolver visits the reported coordinates to verify the hazard, calculate exact material requirements, and generate an itemized quote with turnaround time estimates.
